symbols.name: FileSystemKindProbe
symbols.summary: Observes local, SMB and Linux NFS filesystems without creating the proposed directory.
symbols.remarks: The result describes the current mount or accessible ancestor. It does not qualify storage durability or coordination. Mount options and credentials are not returned.

symbols.name: IsUncPath(string)
symbols.summary: Recognizes ordinary and extended Windows UNC paths without accessing a server.

returns.description: Whether the path names a UNC namespace. Local extended paths and device paths return false.
Whether the path names a UNC namespace. Local extended paths and device paths return false.

symbols.name: ClassifyLinux(string)
symbols.summary: Classifies a Linux mount-table filesystem name without accessing the filesystem.

parameters.description: The case-sensitive filesystem name, without mount options.

returns.description: The supported local or remote kind, or Unsupported for an unrecognized name, including null.

parameters.description: The case-sensitive filesystem name, without mount options.

returns.description: The supported local or remote kind, or Unsupported for an unrecognized name, including null.

symbols.name: Probe(string)
symbols.summary: Observes the filesystem containing a fully qualified path, which need not exist yet.
symbols.remarks: Linux selects the longest matching mount in /proc/self/mountinfo. Windows recognizes local drives and inspects the nearest existing directory on network drives for SMB 3 or later. Native filesystem access can block or throw I/O and access exceptions.

parameters.description: The normalized absolute path to inspect.

returns.description: The supported observed kind, or Unsupported when the native protocol cannot be identified or the host is neither Windows nor Linux.
